title: Notes cannot be opened by keyboard or screen reader: list rows are click-only, with no role, tabindex or current-state
evidence: Rows are plain <li> with a delegated click listener (app.js:30-33). No tabindex, button, key handler or aria-current. The active note is marked only by a #eef background (styles.css:10, about 1.1:1 against white).
failing_case: Tab through the page: focus goes Search, New note, Title, Body, never into the list. A keyboard-only user can create notes but can never open an existing one (WCAG 2.1.1 Keyboard, level A; 1.4.1 for the colour-only active state).
remediation: Render each row as a <button> (or a link) inside the <li> with aria-current on the open note, and give the active state a non-colour cue.

title: Server-supplied and stored note titles are written into innerHTML unescaped (stored XSS)
evidence: app.js:46 builds markup from s.title (response of /api/shared, other users' notes) and inserts it with insertAdjacentHTML. app.js:11 does the same with n.title via `list.innerHTML +=`, and titles are persisted to localStorage (store.js:25) and re-rendered on every load (app.js:50). No escaping or textContent anywhere.
failing_case: Another user shares a note titled ``; the first search keystroke that returns it runs the script in this origin. Locally: type that string into the title box, wait 500 ms, click New note: renderList writes it into the list and the handler runs, and it runs again on every page load because it is saved.
remediation: Build list items with createElement and textContent (or escape at the one render function) for both the local and the shared rows; drop the inline onclick and use the delegated listener.

title: Delete control is an unnamed div that is invisible until mouse hover: unreachable by keyboard, screen reader and touch
evidence: app.js:12 uses <div class="del"> with an emoji and no role, name or tabindex. styles.css:12 sets `.del { opacity: 0; }` and reveals it only on `li:hover`.
failing_case: On a phone there is no hover, so the delete icon never appears; with a keyboard it cannot be focused. Only a mouse user can delete (WCAG 2.1.1 and 4.1.2, level A).
remediation: Use a <button aria-label="Delete note: TITLE"> that is always visible (or revealed on :focus-within as well as :hover and always shown on touch).

title: Clicking a shared search result crashes openNote and nulls the current note
evidence: Shared rows (app.js:46) are <li> elements inside #list with no data-id. closest('li') matches them, Number(undefined) is NaN, notes.find returns undefined, so app.js:17 sets currentNote = undefined and app.js:18 throws on `.title`.
failing_case: Search for a term that returns a shared note, click it: Uncaught TypeError at app.js:18. currentNote is now undefined, the editor still shows the previous note, and any further typing hits the null-target crash in the save timer, losing that text.
remediation: Render shared rows as a separate, non-clickable (or separately handled) list; make openNote return early when the id is not found before assigning currentNote.

title: Search responses are applied out of order and appended; no debounce, abort or status check
evidence: Each input event fires a fetch and, on return, appends its results to the list (app.js:46) without checking that q is still the current query. renderList(q) for a newer keystroke has already cleared the list. res.ok is never checked and the catch only console.logs (app.js:47).
failing_case: Type 'ab' quickly. Request 'a' returns after renderList('ab') ran: its rows are appended. Request 'ab' returns: its rows are appended again, so the list shows stale and duplicated shared results. Any later renderList (open, delete) wipes them with no sign.
remediation: Debounce the input, use an AbortController and cancel the previous request, ignore a response whose query no longer matches, check res.ok, and show an error row on failure.

title: Viewport meta disables pinch zoom
evidence: index.html:5 sets maximum-scale=1 on the viewport.
failing_case: A low-vision user on a phone cannot enlarge the 12 px hint, 16 px list text or the editor (WCAG 1.4.4 Resize Text, AA).
remediation: Use `width=device-width, initial-scale=1` only.

title: Title and body fields have no label or name; search relies on its placeholder
evidence: index.html:19 and :20 have no <label>, aria-label or placeholder. index.html:13 uses only a placeholder as the name of Search.
failing_case: A screen reader announces 'edit text' for the title and 'edit multiline' for the body; a sighted user with an empty title field sees an unmarked box (WCAG 1.3.1, 3.3.2, 4.1.2, level A).
remediation: Add visible or visually hidden labels ('Note title', 'Note text', 'Search notes') tied by for/id.

title: Unguarded JSON.parse at load: one bad saved value blanks the whole app
evidence: store.js:2 runs at top level with no try. If it throws, store.js aborts, app.js then hits ReferenceError on `notes` at its first use (app.js:6/50) and no listener is attached. A parse result that is not an array (e.g. `{}`) or a record without `title` also throws at app.js:6 (`n.title.toLowerCase()`). A browser that blocks storage makes getItem itself throw.
failing_case: localStorage.notes = '{bad' (truncated write, another tool, a previous shape). Reload: blank page with a console SyntaxError; New note and Search do nothing and the user cannot reach, export or repair the data.
remediation: One guarded loader: try/catch the read and parse, check Array.isArray and each record's shape, keep the raw value under a backup key on failure, start empty, and tell the user. Version the saved shape.

title: Typing with no current note throws inside the timer and the text is silently discarded
evidence: currentNote starts null (store.js:3) and is set to null again by removeNote (app.js:26), but the editor inputs are always enabled and removeNote does not clear them. Input events call scheduleSave (app.js:36-37) which dereferences null 500 ms later.
failing_case: First run with no notes: click in the Title box and type. After 500 ms: Uncaught TypeError: Cannot read properties of null (reading 'title'); nothing is saved, no note is created, and the hint still says changes save automatically. Same after deleting the open note: its text stays in the editor and further edits are lost.
remediation: Disable (and clear) the editor when no note is open, show an empty state with 'Create your first note', and guard the save against a null or removed target.

title: Debounced save writes to whatever note is current when the timer fires: edits to the previous note are lost
evidence: scheduleSave captures nothing at schedule time. openNote (app.js:17-19) changes currentNote and overwrites the editor fields without cancelling or flushing saveTimer. The timer then copies the new note's fields into the new note, and the old note's in-memory object was never updated.
failing_case: Open note A, type 'hello' in the body, click note B within 500 ms. B's text replaces the editor; at 500 ms the timer writes B's values into B (a no-op). A's 'hello' is never stored. Nothing tells the user.
remediation: Capture the target note id and values at schedule time (or flush the pending save inside openNote/removeNote/pagehide); one writer per record.

title: Save failures are swallowed while the UI promises "Changes save automatically"
evidence: persist() discards every setItem error (quota full, storage disabled, private mode). Callers (store.js:9, 19, 31) never learn of it, and index.html:21 tells the user changes save automatically.
failing_case: Storage is full or blocked. The user writes a long note, sees the hint, closes the tab: the note is gone, with no message at any point.
remediation: Have persist return a result; on failure show a visible, announced error with the cause and a next step (export the note, free space) and change the hint to reflect saved or unsaved state.

title: Fixed 1200 px layout with a 300 px + 1fr grid: sideways scroll on phones and at 200% zoom
evidence: styles.css:2 fixes the container width; styles.css:7 fixes a 300px sidebar column; no media query or max-width exists in styles.css.
failing_case: At 390 px the page is about 3 times wider than the viewport; the editor sits mostly off-screen to the right and the user must pan sideways to use it. Same at 200% zoom on a 1360 px window.
remediation: Use `max-width: 1200px; width: 100%`, and below about 700 px switch .layout to a single column (list above or behind a toggle, editor full width).

title: Focus indicator removed from every control and not replaced
evidence: styles.css:6 sets outline none for button, input and textarea on :focus. No :focus-visible rule or border/shadow replacement exists in the file. The only other border is 1px #eee (styles.css:13).
failing_case: Tab to New note, Search, Title or Body: nothing changes visually, so a keyboard user cannot tell where they are (WCAG 2.4.7 Focus Visible, AA).
remediation: Delete the rule, or replace it with a visible `:focus-visible` outline (2px, 3:1 contrast against its surround) on all controls.

title: Text contrast far below 4.5:1: save hint, rank badges, hero text and button label
evidence: Computed ratios: #ccc on #fff is about 1.6:1 (styles.css:15, 12 px); #bbb on #fff is about 1.9:1 (styles.css:11); white on #8b5cf6, the right end of the hero gradient, is about 4.2:1 for the 16 px paragraph (styles.css:3); white on #6366f1 is about 4.47:1 for the 14 px button text (styles.css:5).
failing_case: The only save-status text, 'Changes save automatically', and the note rank badges are close to invisible for low-vision users and in sunlight (WCAG 1.4.3, AA).
remediation: Move text colours to tokens that reach 4.5:1 on their backgrounds (for example #595959 on white; use a darker indigo such as #4f46e5 under white text).

quote: const sorted = notes.slice().sort((a, b) => b.updated - a.updated);
title: renderList sorts the whole array once per row and rebuilds the DOM with innerHTML += (quadratic per keystroke)
evidence: app.js:8-9 re-sorts and indexOf-searches inside the forEach; app.js:10 `list.innerHTML +=` re-serialises and reparses the list for every row. renderList runs on every search keystroke (app.js:42). The rank is a business rule computed inside render code.
failing_case: 500 notes: each render does 500 sorts of 500 items (about 2 million comparisons) plus 500 full list reparses, on every keystroke in Search; typing lags visibly and gets worse at 5,000.
remediation: Compute the ranking once per render (a Map of id to rank from one sort), build the rows into a DocumentFragment or one joined string, assign once, and move the rank rule to a pure function.

title: Delete is immediate and unrecoverable, with no confirm or undo
evidence: removeNote calls deleteNote then persists (store.js:29-32) with no confirmation, undo or trash. The 🗑 target sits in the same row that a click otherwise opens (app.js:12, 30).
failing_case: A mouse user clicking near the right of a row after it has revealed the icon deletes the note and its body permanently; there is no way back.
remediation: Add an undo toast (keep the removed note for several seconds before persisting) or a confirm step naming the note.

title: The list is never re-rendered after a save: titles and ranks go stale
evidence: scheduleSave only calls persist(); renderList is called only from search, openNote, removeNote and load (app.js:20, 27, 42, 50). The active row therefore keeps showing the old title and rank.
failing_case: Click New note, rename it to 'Groceries': the list still reads 'Untitled' (and the '#rank' badge is not updated) until the user opens another note or searches.
remediation: Re-render (or update the one row) after the save fires, using the current search filter.

title: Note ids come from Date.now(): two notes created in one millisecond share an id
evidence: createNote (store.js:6-11) uses Date.now() with no uniqueness check. openNote uses notes.find (first match) and deleteNote filters by id, so duplicates are indistinguishable.
failing_case: Two createNote() calls in the same millisecond (scripted or a fast double event): both rows get id N. Clicking the second row always opens the first; deleting either deletes both.
remediation: Use crypto.randomUUID() or a counter checked against existing ids.

title: No flush on pagehide: edits in the last 500 ms are lost on close or refresh
evidence: The only write path for edits is the 500 ms timer (store.js:15-20). No pagehide, visibilitychange or beforeunload handler exists in app.js or store.js.
failing_case: Type a sentence and reload or close the tab within half a second: the timer never fires and the sentence is not stored.
remediation: Register pagehide/visibilitychange handlers that cancel the timer and write the pending values synchronously.

quote: Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet, your notes, supercharged.
title: Placeholder lorem ipsum and a 'Welcome to' hero shipped as the visible header copy
evidence: index.html:11 renders 'Welcome to NoteMaster' with a sparkle emoji and a subtitle that starts with lorem ipsum.
failing_case: Every visitor sees a half-Latin tagline above the app and the hero occupies about 150 px of the first screen before the New note button.
remediation: Replace with a real one-line tagline (or drop the hero) so the toolbar sits at the top of the page.
